name: SRDF-based Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that uses a Ray-Specific Density Function (SRDF) to model volume density, distinct from standard SDF-based density, to address depth ambiguities and improve surface reconstruction accuracy for thin/small objects.
summary: SRDF-based Volume Rendering models volume density using a Ray-Specific Signed Distance Function to prevent false local maxima and noisy surface reconstruction in multi-object scenes.
